kaikki_vikisozluk.e: وَزِير الْخَارِجِيَّة • (wazīr al-ḵārijiyya) m (plural وُزَرَاء الْخَارِجِيَّة (wuzarāʔ al-ḵārijiyya))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, "minister of the exterior", from وَزِير (wazīr, “minister”) + الْخارِجِيَّة (al-ḵārijiyya, “the exterior”).
g: foreign secretary, foreign minister, Secretary of State
